notes.title: Gameplay improvements
notes.content:
Several gameplay changes were made to make the game more intuitive.

[b]Changes[/b]

-More information, tips and instructions are given to the player.

-Chat can now be paused so you can read the conversations at your own pace.

-Letter panel is now easier to interact and understand.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content: Minor tweaks have been made to the game so that it runs better.
